geopower.book.1:
§lGeoPower§r

Power from the world: sun, wind, water and heat.

Cables carry it to electric furnaces and to the iron farm.

Right-click any GeoPower block to see what it holds and what it lacks.
geopower.book.2:
§lGenerators§r

§lSolar panel§r: open sky, daytime; 20 FE/t at noon, rain halves it.

§lWind turbine§r: the higher above y 63, the more; needs open air around it. Up to 32 FE/t in a storm.
geopower.book.3:
§lHydro§r: water at its sides; still 1, flowing 4, falling 6 FE/t per side.

§lGeothermal§r: lava (source 8, flowing 4), magma 2, fire 1 FE/t per side. Below y 0 ×1.5, in the Nether ×1.25.
geopower.book.4:
§lUniversal cables§r

Join generators to machines. The weakest cable decides how much gets through:

Basic: 200 FE/t
Advanced: 800
Elite: 3200
Ultimate: 12800
geopower.book.5:
§lUpgrading§r

Right-click a cable with an alloy to upgrade it and every joined cable of the same tier (up to 64).

Infused: Basic → Advanced
Reinforced: → Elite
Atomic: → Ultimate
geopower.book.6:
§lElectric furnaces§r

Furnace: everything, twice as fast, 20 FE/t.
Blast furnace: ores, 4× as fast, 40 FE/t.
Smoker: food, 4× as fast, 20 FE/t.

The flame shows the charge. None needs fuel.
geopower.book.7:
§lThe iron farm§r

3×3 wide, 4 layers high, built like a real iron farm: the collection floor, the lava blade above it, the village pod and the roof with the zombie.

It turns power into iron.
geopower.book.8:

(top row = front)

  S  T  S
  S  P  S

geopower.book.12:
§lRunning it§r

A cable to the power port: 40 FE/t, an iron ingot every 15 s, a poppy with every fourth.

The ingots wait in the controller (right-click opens it); a hopper under it takes them out. Right-click names missing blocks.
